businesses.business: Engineered aerospace, defense and process flow equipment

offering_description.value: Crane develops proprietary engineered solutions for aerospace and defense customers. It designs and manufactures equipment to measure and control fluids and gases for industrial customers and provides on-site valve maintenance for nuclear power plants.

quotes.quote: We push the boundaries of innovation, delivering proprietary solutions that set new standards for mission-critical performance across aerospace, defense, and other demanding environments.

Crane Nuclear is a premier provider of sensors, diagnostic flow control diagnostic and calibration equipment, on-site services, and certified “N-stamp” valves for the global nuclear power market. Serving the nuclear power industry Crane Nuclear was a pioneer in valve diagnostic and testing technology, and the industry looks to Crane Nuclear to provide a highly skilled and qualified workforce to perform valve maintenance, ensuring plant safety and reliability.
